frequency_question: What proportion of major drafted central industrial/transport subsidy schemes are formally notified and launched within 12 months of initial public signaling?
membership_rule: Includes central ministry schemes involving direct financial incentives, subsidies, or credit guarantees for automotive/manufacturing sectors in India over the past 10 years; excludes state-level policies and purely regulatory standards without financial backing.

cases.name: PLI Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry
PLI Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery
National Green Hydrogen Mission Financial Incentive Schemes

coverage_note: 7 named major recent central schemes matching the fiscal incentive profile; believed roughly 8 in total for this specific class.
known_gaps: Minor inter-ministerial consultative delays that pushed timelines by a few weeks are absorbed into the hit category if eventually launched within the window.
validity_reason: The procedural machinery and bureaucratic momentum for central industrial incentive schemes in India remain stable under the current administrative framework through the decade.
